Apple Shares Six 'Shot on iPhone Duo' Photos

For the past decade, Apple has used its 'Shot on iPhone' campaign to showcase the camera capabilities of each new iPhone.

From everyday users to renowned photographers and filmmakers, Apple has leveraged the campaign to promote new camera hardware, shooting modes, and other iPhone-exclusive photography features.

The long-running campaign has also won multiple Cannes Lions awards, including two Grand Prix, and has received two Emmy nominations for Outstanding Commercial.

Today, Apple published a new carousel post on its Instagram showcasing the iPhone Duo's 'versatile camera system with exciting new capabilities.'

You can see the six photos taken by photographers Jake Michaels and Jason Nocito below:

The iPhone Duo, which features a 48-megapixel rear camera, 12-megapixel front camera, and a built-under-display FaceTime camera, will be available for pre-order starting Friday, October 16, with shipping and in-store availability beginning October 23.

Apple previously announced that customers can begin preparing for iPhone Duo pre-orders starting October 12 — read more about that here.

Planning to get the iPhone Duo? Let us know in the comments.
